GPT-6.2 Astra is great at robotics:

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet Greg Brockman megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: XDOF (@xdofai); megjelent: 2026-11-20T16:53:20+00:00; link: https://x.com/xdofai/status/2123822009696342190; média: 1 kép]
GPT 6.2 Astra has scored a whopping 41.2%(!) on Ember-0, one of our robotics benchmarks.

This is a HUGE jump from early Sept, when GPT 6 Astra scored 19.6%.

We expect Ember-0 to be saturated very soon.
